headline: Grumpy Walrus sold 1M SNEK for ~3,011 ADA at 8:19 PM ET (a Minswap market order, not a vault loan) and from 9:22 to 10:02 PM ET built a new ~42.7M Valhalla (VAL) position, 4.27% of the 1B supply, for ~1,268 ADA in seven buys starting 3 minutes after VAL minted at 9:19 PM ET. VAL is a Solada launch (Cardano-side native token); the curve still holds ~67% of supply with ~2.2k ADA in it, and there are 31 holder addresses. The risk scanner has no rating for this VAL; a same-name 'valhalla' on Snek.fun (different policy) is tagged RUG and Dev sold, so don't confuse them. Net ADA about +1,491. UNFAZED (Solada) showed a six-wallet coordinated buy, a tagged first-block sniper, three repeat early buyers and two sniper full exits; risk score red 30. CORE shows one cluster holding 71.4%. Nothing passes k/y; no open tickets.
learned: The Grumpy Walrus again opened a fresh launch within minutes of mint (VAL, 3 minutes after mint, after NOX at 10 minutes), funded by a SNEK sale, so its fresh-launch buys are a repeating pattern.
Copycat tickers exist across launchpads: a Snek.fun 'valhalla' rugged within minutes while the Solada VAL the whale bought is a different policy, so always match by policy, not ticker.
